verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents PDF partitioning into structured document elements and metadata. An Auto strategy routes each page to Fast, High Res or VLM partitioning, and add-ons cover generative OCR and table-to-HTML enrichment, so the core of parsing complex PDFs into structured output is evidenced. However, none of the evidence specifically addresses the story's complex-layout requirements, and nothing independent verifies parse accuracy. missing for 10: explicit multi-column reading-order handling, header/footer detection or removal, footnote handling, independent or hands-on accuracy corroboration on complex real-world PDFs.
